scope: Public-source screening for a TS + EIS + DRT research pipeline. Evidence levels are 0 = not established, 1 = partial public indication, 2 = explicit public indication. Scores support audit planning only; they do not prove a scientific match.

candidates.name: LFP SOC EIS and sine-wave pulse dataset
candidates.known_from_source: Commercial 26650 LFP cells; EIS and short-period sine-wave pulse material; CC0 licence.
candidates.audit_question: Do an EIS file and a pulse file expose the same SOC, temperature, cell, and acquisition identifiers?

candidates.name: Early-stage fast-charging ageing dataset
candidates.known_from_source: Twelve Samsung INR18650-20R cells with raw cycling, characterisation, temperature, and post-ageing EIS; CC BY 4.0.
candidates.audit_question: Can cycle, cell, check-up, temperature, and EIS test identifiers be joined without inference?

candidates.name: Degradation path indicators for lithium-ion batteries
candidates.known_from_source: 48 cells with ageing, check-ups, pulses, pseudo-OCV, EIS, and BOL/EOL DRT peak files.
candidates.audit_question: Can BOL/EOL spectra, cycles, and published DRT peak files be linked through the cell archive and metrics workbook?

candidates.name: Online battery EIS prediction dataset
candidates.known_from_source: Dynamic current and voltage groups are published alongside EIS trajectories, frequency, real, and imaginary components.
candidates.audit_question: Does each dynamic profile preserve a stable identifier to its corresponding EIS trajectory after source conversion?

candidates.name: A123 LFP multimodal electrochemical dataset
candidates.known_from_source: 71 cells with charge-discharge, EIS, CV, ICA, and PITT files organised by cell number.
candidates.audit_question: Does shared cell numbering represent compatible state and protocol, rather than only a broad per-cell association?

candidates.name: Oxford multisine Li-ion EIS dataset
candidates.known_from_source: Raw current and voltage time series support independent EIS linearity, stationarity, and operando reconstruction checks.
candidates.audit_question: Which MATLAB variables define the excitation, voltage response, operating condition, and reconstructed impedance?

candidates.name: Lithium-ion EIS dataset with fitting and degradation modes
candidates.known_from_source: Eight Samsung INR18650-30Q cells, periodic check-ups at 25-cycle steps, EIS, capacity fade, and degradation modes.
candidates.audit_question: Which columns and identifiers support a stable EIS-versus-ageing comparison?

candidates.name: DigiCell 54-cell NMC811 EIS dataset
candidates.known_from_source: 54 EIS CSV files at 30% SOC with CSVW and JSON-LD metadata.
candidates.audit_question: Can its declared CSVW schema map directly into the local EIS intake contract?

candidates.name: TUM LG MJ1 ageing, charging, and BEV-profile dataset
candidates.known_from_source: Ten commercial LG Chem INR18650 MJ1 cells with ageing measurements, capacity and resistance values, BEV application profiles, charging curves, and a quasi-stationary OCV curve.
candidates.audit_question: Which identifiers link cell, ageing state, charging curve, and BEV profile, and is any EIS data present in the raw archive despite not being described in the public metadata?

candidates.name: TUM experimental degradation study of commercial lithium-ion cells
candidates.role: Large-scale time-series, SOH, and degradation-label reference
candidates.known_from_source: 196 commercial NCA/silicon-doped graphite cells under calendar, cyclic, and dynamic operating conditions, with periodic check-ups and capacity, resistance, LLI, LAM_NE, and LAM_PE labels.
candidates.audit_question: Which raw files expose the operational time series and periodic check-up identifiers, and is EIS absent or available as supplementary material?

candidates.name: NASA PCoE lithium-ion battery ageing dataset
candidates.role: Legacy TS and impedance screening candidate
candidates.known_from_source: The landing record describes charge, discharge, and impedance operations at multiple temperatures, with 10 Hz acquisition and ageing to an end-of-life criterion.
candidates.audit_question: Does the accessible legacy archive retain stable battery, cycle, temperature, and operation identifiers that allow charge/discharge records to be paired with impedance records without inference?

candidates.name: Broadband EIS with voltage and current acquisition across SOC
candidates.known_from_source: The associated open tools describe raw voltage/current acquisition files and broadband EIS data for lithium-ion batteries at different states of charge.
candidates.audit_question: Can one acquisition record be linked to one impedance spectrum through cell, SOC, repeat, and test-condition identifiers, with units and frequency ordering preserved?

candidates.name: RWTH EIS Data Analytics reproducibility benchmark
candidates.known_from_source: The public analytics project includes Lin-KK, equivalent-circuit and DRT fitting workflows, plus reported EIS-based SOC, SOH, temperature, and phase prediction examples.
candidates.audit_question: Which example inputs are redistributable, and can their documented preprocessing and fitting workflow be reproduced as a non-primary method baseline?
